description: An IBAN checker that validates the country, the length and the check digits — and says which failed. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

iban.description: The account number to check, written however you have it: 'DK50 0040 0440 1162 43' and 'dk5000400440116243' are the same thing. Spaces, hyphens and case are ignored.
